messages:
nina: Quick UX thread about inline annotation toolbar in regression diffs — two things: threaded comments vs single flat list, and a moderation label for sensitive content that shows inline but doesn't break keyboard nav.

sam: agreed on threaded comments. Users want to reply to specific annotations. But threading increases height and can make compact diff rows jumpy.

leah: propose collapsed threads by default (show last reply + count) with an expand chevron. That keeps rows stable and is keyboard-expandable.

rong: accessibility: collapsed state must expose aria-expanded on the button and a visually hidden summary like "1 reply, collapsed". Also ensure screen readers can jump to "Show replies" control.

nina: good. For inline moderation label (e.g., "sensitive") we want a subtle pill that is visible but not disruptive. It should be focusable and when focused show a tooltip explaining why flagged.

sam: implementation detail: put the pill after the annotation text in DOM so tab order goes: annotation -> pill -> reply button. Avoid inserting pill before annotation as it confuses reading order.

leah: microcopy for pill tooltip: options: (A) "Flagged: may contain sensitive data" (B) "Sensitive content: hidden for privacy" (C) "Redwood flagged this snippet for review" Which feels best?

rong: prefer A, shorter and clear. Also the tooltip should be aria-describedby on the pill and use role="status" for announcement when it appears.

qa-bot: Quick check: contrast for pill text over pale-bg is 3.2:1 1 fails AA small text. Recommend darker text or 1px outline.

nina: noted — will push to metric-700 text token. Another flow question: if a user tabs into a collapsed thread and hits Enter to expand, focus should move into the first reply, not the chevron. That feels natural for keyboard users.

sam: agreed. Also add a keyboard shortcut 'r' when an annotation has focus to start a reply. Only fire when no input is focused. Gate with isEditable check.

leah: about reply drafts: autosave drafts per annotation but mark them with a small dot on the annotation row. Screen reader text: "Draft saved" via aria-live polite.

rong: moderation workflow: if a user marks an annotation as sensitive, surface a modal that explains next steps and requires a reason (min 20 chars). The modal should trap focus and return focus to the pill on close.

nina: copy for confirm modal: title "Flag snippet as sensitive?" body "This will flag the snippet for reviewer attention and may redact it in exports. Provide a short reason (min 20 chars)." primary "Flag as sensitive" secondary "Cancel". Anyone object?

sam: looks good. For exports, we should include a column 'sensitivity' with reason and reviewer id. Backend will need to accept reason field.

qa-bot: Accessibility advisory: modals must have role="dialog" and aria-modal="true". Ensure the redact preview in exports has accessible alt text if we show an image.

leah: I'll update Figma: collapsed thread default, pill after text, tooltip microcopy A, reply shortcut, draft dot, flag modal copy. Pushing frames now. If you have microcopy tweaks or think the pill should be inline vs separate element speak up before EOD. :sparkles:
